instruction: Go into the Maps app and open settings of the app.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' | grep -q "Maps" >/dev/null && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Settings" >/dev/null && echo "True" || echo "False"
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' | grep -q "Maps" >/dev/null && echo "True" || echo "False"
